snippet.title: 🎮 The Basket: 1 on 1 Plus (PlayStation) Complete Gameplay
snippet.description:
Simple 1500 Series Vol. 30: The Basket - 1 on 1 Plus is a 3D basketball game focused on simplicity and fun. Players can choose from a variety of characters, including humans, monkeys, and even angels, each with special abilities to shoot, dribble, or block the opponent. The game features 1-on-1 matches and 2-on-2 duos, bringing a touch of humor and creativity. As part of a collection, it aims to be accessible and unpretentious, with simple yet effective graphics and mechanics for those seeking a casual and straightforward title.

Developer: Jorudan 
Publisher: D3Publisher 
Release date: 2000 
Platform: Sony PlayStation
